about: Transaction tax on a buy, by ISIN, for 2026 trades, from each tax authority's own list or rule (taxMap.mjs reads it). rate null = no source settles it.

sources.HMRC_RATE: https://www.gov.uk/tax-buy-shares — HMRC: 0.5% SDRT/stamp duty when you buy existing shares in a company incorporated in the UK or in a foreign company that has a share register in the UK (read 2026-10-20)
sources.HMRC_CHARGEABLE: https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/stamp-taxes-shares-manual/stsm031090 — STSM031090 chargeable securities (s.99 FA 1986): excludes securities of a company incorporated outside the UK with no UK register, and securities admitted to a recognised growth market but not listed on any market; updated 2 Sep 2026
sources.HMRC_RGM: https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/stamp-taxes-shares-manual/stsm041270 + https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/stamp-taxes-shares-manual/stsm041330 — growth-market exemption (s.99(4B) FA 1986: admitted to a recognised growth market and not listed on that or any other market); recognised growth markets list includes AIM and the AQSE Growth Market of Aquis Stock Exchange (from 28 Apr 2014); both updated 2 Sep 2026
sources.HMRC_RELIEFS: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/stamp-duty-reserve-tax-reliefs-and-exemptions — HMRC SDRT reliefs: growth-market shares not listed on any market are exempt (read 2026-10-20)
sources.SI_2013_460: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/460/regulation/3/made — Building Societies (Core Capital Deferred Shares) Regulations 2013 reg. 3: s.109 Building Societies Act 1986 stamp exemption (and its SDRT counterpart) does not apply to CCDS
sources.LSE_API: https://api.londonstockexchange.com/api/gw/lse/search/autocomplete?q=<ISIN> + /instruments/alldata/<TIDM> — LSE instrument data (market MAINMARKET/AIM/ATT/OTHERS, segment, country, MiFIR type, fund flag), read 2026-10-20
sources.ISSUER_DUAL: https://live.euronext.com/sites/default/files/company_press_releases/attachments/2026/06/08/Connect_20260608-axs-notice-preliminary-results-and-investor-presentation.pdf (Accsys: AIM + Euronext Amsterdam) and https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/THR/asx-waiver-re-listing-rule-732-7fxz41x5bvudxea.html (Thor Energy: AIM + ASX official list) — issuer disclosures of a listing outside AIM, 2026
sources.REV_CREST: https://www.revenue.ie/en/property/stamp-duty/other-stamp-duty/crest/index.aspx — Revenue: 'A Stamp Duty charge of 1% arises where the transfer of Irish securities takes place electronically' (CREST / Euroclear, s.78E SDCA 1999); page published 07/07/2026
sources.REV_P7: https://www.revenue.ie/en/tax-professionals/tdm/stamp-duty/stamp-duty-manual/part-07-exemptions-and-reliefs-from-stamp-duty/part-07.pdf — Stamp Duty Manual Part 7 (updated Jan 2026): s.86A Euronext Growth exemption (never covered AIM) repealed by FA 2025 from 1 Jan 2026; s.88 exempts units in investment undertakings (s.739B TCA) and shares of companies not incorporated in the State
sources.REV_86B: https://www.revenue.ie/en/tax-professionals/tdm/stamp-duty/stamp-duty-manual/part-07-exemptions-and-reliefs-from-stamp-duty/section-86B-market-capitalisation.pdf — Stamp Duty Manual s.86B (updated Oct 2026): 1 Jan 2026–31 Dec 2030 exemption for securities on a regulated market/MTF/equivalent non-EU market (LSE and Euronext Growth named) whose issuer had market cap < €1bn on 1 Dec of prior year, only during an exemption period opened by a valid notification to Revenue
sources.REV_86B_LIST: https://www.revenue.ie/en/property/documents/stamp-duty/market-cap-notifications-2025.pdf — Revenue list of valid s.86B notifications for year 2025 (exemption periods in 2026), document last updated 22/09/2026

sources.MEF2026: https://www.mef.gov.it/pubblicita_legale/societa_2026.html — MEF list (DM 21/2/2013 art.17 c.3) of Italian-resident companies with avg Nov-2025 cap < EUR 500m whose shares are FTT-exempt in 2026; Section A (Italian RM/MTF, 316 ISINs of main share class: Elenco-ITF-2025-Sezione-A.xlsx) and Section B (foreign venues: Newron, Genenta only); published Dec 2025, read 2026-10-20
sources.ADE2026: https://www.agenziaentrate.gov.it/portale/schede/pagamenti/imposta-sulle-transazioni-finanziarie/infogen-imposta-transazioni-finanziarie — Agenzia Entrate: share FTT 0.4% (0.2% until 31/12/2025), halved for trades on regulated markets/MTFs -> 0.2% from 1/1/2026 (L. 199/2025 art.1 c.28-30 amending L. 228/2012 c.491); read 2026-10-20

SICAV excluded), art.15 c.1 f (list-based exclusion), art.17 c.2 (newly admitted shares presumed below EUR 500m until a November average exists), art.17 c.4 (all share classes counted together)
